title: The scaled generalization of Tepper's identity
statement:
Let $l$ be a positive integer, and let $P(x)$ be a real polynomial of degree $n$ with leading coefficient $a_n$. **Scaled generalized Tepper identity.** One has

$$
\sum_{k=0}^{n}(-1)^k {n \choose k}P(x-lk)=a_n l^n n!.
$$

The preceding theorem proves the case $l=1$ for arbitrary real polynomials. The displayed statement is presented as a conjectural generalization; the supplied text gives no resolution evidence for the scaled case.
source_name: Mortaza Bayat and Hossein Teimoori Faal, “A Generalization of Tepper's Identity”, arXiv:2205.04237 (2022).
